metas.description: Two cousins inherit illegal goods after their uncle's death and create a mobile game, 'Siko Siko,' to sell them through it – until a mob boss appears claiming to be the real owner. Yango Play exclusive premiere.
metas.name: سيكو سيكو

metas.description: Several couples navigate romantic and comedic situations over the course of a few hours in one day. Yango Play exclusive premiere.
metas.name: بضع ساعات في يوم ما

metas.description: A retired accountant, captive to the memories of an old incomplete love story, chances upon his old flame – now a housewife – and their romance is rekindled as they got older. Yango Play exclusive premiere.
metas.name: فيها إيه يعني
